fix.message: The ink-toon look module is not used: start from scripts/new-lesson.mjs.
Lit kit materials break the cel look (and come out shiny and shaded): build every drawn object with the look's builders or look.ink(geometry, colour, name).
Own materials break the cel look (a toon or Lambert material waits for a lamp and is black on the headset): use look.mat(colour) or the look's builders.

note.message: No inked builders used: draw the hero and the props with look.ink or the look's builders, so they get two tones and an ink line (references/recipes.md).
Toon props move on twos: drive their motion from lookTwos(time) and land each pose with an overshoot (references/teaching.md, Motion).
No effect marks: draw the action in (speed lines on what moves, impact ticks where it lands, an arrow for the push, steam, a motion arc) (references/teaching.md).
No step word: name each step's action with one big lettered word on paper (look.stepWord), low at the front of the sheet.
